# L-Be · Liron Bialkovich (לירון ביאלקוביץ)

> L-Be is the consultancy of Liron Bialkovich (לירון ביאלקוביץ), an independent consultant and developer in Israel who implements CRM systems, AI systems and business automation for companies. The site is in Hebrew.

- Name: לירון ביאלקוביץ (Hebrew) / Liron Bialkovich (English)
- Brand: L-Be (l-be.com). SubK (subk.co.il) is his earlier brand and now points to L-Be.
- Liron Bialkovich is an independent consultant and developer who builds AI systems, automations and CRM systems for companies. At L-Be he specifies, sets up and implements CRM systems, AI solutions and automated processes.
- Developing companies and businesses since 2013; independent since 2017. More than 300 projects; more than 80 business owners and companies, up to 100 employees.
- Some clients have been with him for 11 consecutive years; client churn is about 3%.
- First consultation is free. Prices, phone number and address are not published.

## Pages

- [AI mode: facts, FAQ and site tree](https://l-be.com/ai): the hub for AI agents; every page has a plain version at https://l-be.com/ai-<page>
- [The whole site on one plain page](https://l-be.com/ai-all)
- [About Liron Bialkovich](https://l-be.com/liron-bialkovich.md): story, background and vision
- [Solutions](https://l-be.com/solutions.md): the detailed list of solutions
- [Case study: הבית של עידה](https://l-be.com/case-study.md): a 30-person home furniture and design company; the whole business in one process from sale to collection, with an AI layer connected to every department
- [Digital dreams: system specification for founders](https://l-be.com/digital-dreams): why planning costs less than building, and five working rules for specifying complex systems
- [L-Be, the business operating system](https://l-be.com/business-ai): one place where people and AI agents work together, with tasks, seats and ownership, approval gates, dashboards, BI and AI traffic management; AI proposes, a person decides
- [Kala CRM: an Israeli CRM system](https://l-be.com/kala-crm): Liron has accompanied its development since day one and implements it for Israeli companies
- [GoHighLevel (GHL) in Israel](https://l-be.com/gohighlevel): GHL setup for companies, help for founders already on GHL, and setting up a GHL agency, in Hebrew
- [Privacy policy](https://l-be.com/privacy): no cookies, no tracking; personal details are sent only through forms
- [Terms of use](https://l-be.com/terms)
- [Accessibility statement and glossary](https://l-be.com/accessibility): how the site was made accessible, and plain-language definitions of the abbreviations used
- [Home](https://l-be.com/): services, consulting offer, projects, clients, original client messages, contact form
